policy.purpose: Provide a readable bilingual baseline for every canonical Concept without requiring a full Guide.

en.summary: {title} is a core mechanism or representation that changes how an AI system behaves or should be designed.
en.mentalModel: Treat {title} as part of the system mechanism, not as a label: ask what inputs it transforms, what constraints it introduces, and what behavior it changes.
en.whyItMatters: Understanding this mechanism prevents architectural decisions from being based on surface-level model behavior alone.

zh-CN.summary: 「{title}」描述一个会影响 AI 系统行为或设计方式的核心机制或表示。
zh-CN.mentalModel: 不要只把「{title}」当作术语；要追问它接收什么输入、引入什么约束，以及最终改变了什么系统行为。
zh-CN.whyItMatters: 理解这个机制，可以避免仅凭模型表面表现做架构判断。

en.summary: {title} is a reasoning lens for making an AI design boundary explicit instead of relying on intuition.
en.mentalModel: Use {title} to separate responsibilities and trade-offs before choosing prompts, models, tools, or runtime controls.
en.whyItMatters: Clear mental boundaries reduce designs that look convincing in a demo but fail when real data, state, or side effects appear.

zh-CN.summary: 「{title}」是一种把 AI 系统设计边界显式化的思考框架，而不是依赖直觉。
zh-CN.mentalModel: 使用「{title}」先拆清责任与权衡，再决定 Prompt、模型、工具或 Runtime 控制应该放在哪里。
zh-CN.whyItMatters: 清晰的心智边界可以减少 Demo 看似正确、遇到真实数据、状态或 Side Effect 就失效的设计。

en.summary: {title} is a repeatable working move that makes an AI task more controllable, inspectable, and verifiable.
en.mentalModel: Treat {title} as an explicit step with inputs, a decision, and observable acceptance evidence rather than an informal habit.
en.whyItMatters: Repeatable practice turns one-off AI success into a workflow that can be reviewed, debugged, and improved.

zh-CN.summary: 「{title}」是一种可重复执行的工作动作，用来让 AI 任务更可控、可检查、可验证。
zh-CN.mentalModel: 把「{title}」设计成具有明确输入、判断和验收证据的步骤，而不是一种模糊习惯。
zh-CN.whyItMatters: 可重复的 Practice 才能把一次性的 AI 成功变成可审查、可调试、可持续改进的工作流。

en.summary: {title} is a reusable engineering pattern for placing responsibility, control, and failure handling in the right layer.
en.mentalModel: Apply {title} when a recurring system boundary needs an explicit contract instead of prompt-level hope or hidden convention.
en.whyItMatters: Stable patterns reduce ambiguous ownership and make failures easier to contain, diagnose, and recover from.

zh-CN.summary: 「{title}」是一种可复用的工程模式，用于把责任、控制和失败处理放到正确的系统层。
zh-CN.mentalModel: 当同一种边界反复出现时，用「{title}」建立显式 Contract，而不是依赖 Prompt 期待或隐含约定。
zh-CN.whyItMatters: 稳定的 Pattern 能减少责任歧义，并让失败更容易隔离、诊断和恢复。

en.summary: {title} is a recurring AI-system failure mode that can look harmless locally while distorting system-level decisions.
en.mentalModel: Treat {title} as something to expose with evidence and guardrails, not something to wish away with a stronger prompt.
en.whyItMatters: Unmodeled risks tend to surface late, after they are entangled with users, data, or irreversible actions.

zh-CN.summary: 「{title}」是一类反复出现的 AI 系统风险，局部看似无害，却可能扭曲系统级判断。
zh-CN.mentalModel: 把「{title}」当作需要证据和 Guardrail 暴露的失败面，而不是试图用更强 Prompt 把它隐藏掉。
zh-CN.whyItMatters: 未建模的风险往往会在已经连接用户、数据或不可逆操作之后才暴露。

en.summary: {title} is an explicit subsystem or lifecycle responsibility that should be designed, observed, and tested rather than hidden inside a model call.
en.mentalModel: Model {title} with clear inputs, state, outputs, limits, and failure behavior so the surrounding application can reason about it.
en.whyItMatters: Production reliability depends on software-visible boundaries, not on assuming the model will coordinate the component correctly.

zh-CN.summary: 「{title}」是一个需要被显式设计、观察和测试的子系统或生命周期责任，而不应该藏在一次模型调用里。
zh-CN.mentalModel: 为「{title}」定义清楚输入、状态、输出、限制和失败行为，让外围应用能够对它进行推理和控制。
zh-CN.whyItMatters: 生产可靠性依赖软件可见的边界，而不是假设模型会自动把组件协调正确。

en.summary: {title} is an operational measurement frame for connecting AI-system behavior to engineering trade-offs.
en.mentalModel: Use {title} as decision evidence: define what is measured, under which workload, and what trade-off or release choice the number should inform.
en.whyItMatters: Metrics without a decision boundary encourage optimization of numbers that do not improve the actual system outcome.

zh-CN.summary: 「{title}」是一套把 AI 系统行为连接到工程权衡的度量框架。
zh-CN.mentalModel: 把「{title}」作为决策证据：明确测量对象、工作负载，以及这个数字最终要支持哪一种 Trade-off 或发布判断。
zh-CN.whyItMatters: 没有决策边界的 Metric 很容易优化数字，却没有改善真实系统结果。

en.summary: The order of information inside context can change which facts and instructions the model attends to and how it resolves competing signals.
en.mentalModel: Think of context as an ordered sequence with position, adjacency, and recency effects—not as an unordered bag of equally visible facts.
en.whyItMatters: With conflicting instructions or retrieved evidence, changing only the order can change model behavior even when the content is identical.

zh-CN.summary: Context 中的信息顺序会改变模型关注哪些事实和指令，也会影响它如何解决相互竞争的信号。
zh-CN.mentalModel: 把 Context 理解成有顺序的序列，而不是所有事实同等可见的信息袋；位置、邻近关系和先后次序都会产生影响。
zh-CN.whyItMatters: 当指令或检索证据存在冲突时，即使内容完全相同，仅调整顺序也可能改变模型行为。

en.summary: Modality grounding ties a claim back to evidence in the original image, audio, video, document, or sensor stream instead of trusting a cross-modal summary.
en.mentalModel: A multimodal representation is an intermediate view; important claims should still be checked against spatial, temporal, or structural evidence in the source modality.
en.whyItMatters: Information can be lost or distorted during modality conversion, especially for precise visual, temporal, or location-sensitive claims.

zh-CN.summary: 模态 Grounding 是把结论重新落到原始图像、音频、视频、文档或传感器证据上，而不是只相信跨模态摘要。
zh-CN.mentalModel: 多模态表示只是中间视图；重要结论仍应回到原始模态，核对其中的空间、时间或结构证据。
zh-CN.whyItMatters: 模态转换会丢失或扭曲信息，尤其容易影响精确的视觉、时序和定位判断。

en.summary: Examples can strongly steer format, tone, and local reasoning patterns, but they do not create an enforceable policy boundary.
en.mentalModel: Use examples as behavioral demonstrations; use runtime checks, permissions, and explicit contracts for guarantees that must hold.
en.whyItMatters: This prevents teams from mistaking few-shot imitation for security, authorization, or correctness enforcement.

zh-CN.summary: 示例可以强烈影响格式、语气和局部推理模式，但它不会形成可强制执行的策略边界。
zh-CN.mentalModel: 把 Example 当作行为示范；对于必须成立的保证，仍要依赖 Runtime 校验、权限和显式 Contract。
zh-CN.whyItMatters: 区分这两者，可以避免把 Few-shot 模仿误认为安全、授权或正确性约束。

en.summary: Planning is useful when the system must explore alternative action sequences before committing to one, rather than simply generating a longer reasoning trace.
en.mentalModel: Treat a plan as search over candidate paths with costs, constraints, observations, and stopping rules.
en.whyItMatters: Extra planning only pays off when exploring alternatives can change the decision; otherwise it adds latency and failure surface.

zh-CN.summary: 当系统需要在执行前比较多条候选行动路径时，Planning 才真正有价值，而不是单纯生成更长的思考过程。
zh-CN.mentalModel: 把 Plan 理解成对候选路径的搜索：每条路径都有成本、约束、观察结果和停止条件。
zh-CN.whyItMatters: 只有探索替代方案能够改变决策时，额外 Planning 才值得；否则它只会增加延迟和失败面。

en.summary: Internal reasoning is not a reliable audit trail; systems should expose observable inputs, actions, outputs, and verification evidence instead.
en.mentalModel: Judge the system through evidence you can inspect and reproduce, not through a persuasive explanation of how it says it reasoned.
en.whyItMatters: Opaque reasoning cannot substitute for traces, tests, source evidence, or runtime facts when debugging or governing a system.

zh-CN.summary: 内部推理并不是可靠的审计记录；系统应暴露可观察的输入、动作、输出和验证证据。
zh-CN.mentalModel: 评价系统时应依赖可检查、可复现的证据，而不是依赖模型对自己如何推理的有说服力解释。
zh-CN.whyItMatters: 不透明推理不能替代 Trace、测试、来源证据和 Runtime 事实，尤其是在调试和治理场景。

en.summary: A person or organization remains responsible for consequential AI outcomes even when generation or decisions are heavily automated.
en.mentalModel: Automation can delegate work, but it cannot erase ownership: define who approves risk, monitors outcomes, and answers for harm or policy violations.
en.whyItMatters: Governance fails when everyone can point to the model while no human role owns the final decision boundary.

zh-CN.summary: 即使生成和判断高度自动化，仍必须有人或组织对高后果 AI 结果承担责任。
zh-CN.mentalModel: 自动化可以委派工作，但不能消除 Owner：需要明确谁批准风险、谁监控结果、谁对伤害或策略违规负责。
zh-CN.whyItMatters: 如果所有人都能把责任推给模型，而没有角色拥有最终决策边界，治理就会失效。

en.summary: Plan before code resolves intent, affected surfaces, constraints, and verification steps before an AI coding agent edits the repository.
en.mentalModel: A useful plan is a small executable hypothesis about what must change and how you will know the change is safe—not a ceremonial essay.
en.whyItMatters: This reduces broad unnecessary edits and makes architectural regressions easier to catch before code generation compounds them.

zh-CN.summary: 先规划再改代码，是在 Coding Agent 动仓库之前先明确 Intent、影响面、约束和验证步骤。
zh-CN.mentalModel: 有用的 Plan 是一个小型、可执行的修改假设：要改什么，以及如何证明它安全；而不是形式化长文。
zh-CN.whyItMatters: 这样可以减少不必要的大范围修改，并在代码生成放大问题之前更早发现架构回归。

en.summary: Context can be structured so stable instructions and reusable prefixes stay consistent while volatile task data changes later in the prompt.
en.mentalModel: Separate stable and dynamic context regions; optimize structure first, then let caching exploit the stable prefix where supported.
en.whyItMatters: Cache-friendly structure can reduce cost and latency without sacrificing clarity about context ownership.

zh-CN.summary: Context 可以被组织成稳定指令与可复用前缀保持不变，而变化频繁的任务数据放在后部动态区域。
zh-CN.mentalModel: 先区分 Stable 与 Dynamic Context，再在支持时让 Cache 利用稳定前缀；不要反过来为了 Cache 破坏上下文结构。
zh-CN.whyItMatters: 这样既能降低成本和延迟，也能保持 Context 责任边界清晰。

en.summary: Prompt caching reuses computation for stable prompt prefixes; it is a performance optimization, not a substitute for context management.
en.mentalModel: Design stable prefixes around genuinely reusable instructions and data, then measure hit rate, invalidation behavior, cost, and latency.
en.whyItMatters: Poor caching can couple prompts to provider details or preserve stale context while delivering little real savings.

zh-CN.summary: Prompt Caching 复用稳定 Prompt 前缀的计算结果；它是性能优化，而不是 Context Management 的替代品。
zh-CN.mentalModel: 围绕真正可复用的指令和数据设计稳定前缀，然后测量命中率、失效行为、成本和延迟。
zh-CN.whyItMatters: 设计不当的 Cache 会让 Prompt 过度绑定 Provider 细节，甚至保留陈旧 Context，却没有带来实际收益。

en.summary: User memory stores person-specific state and preferences, while domain knowledge represents shared facts that should come from governed sources.
en.mentalModel: Keep personalization and source-of-truth knowledge in separate authority domains with different write, expiry, and correction policies.
en.whyItMatters: Mixing them can let one user's remembered preference overwrite authoritative knowledge or leak into another user's context.

zh-CN.summary: User Memory 保存用户特定的状态与偏好，而 Domain Knowledge 表示应来自受治理来源的共享事实。
zh-CN.mentalModel: 把个性化记忆和 Source of Truth 放在不同的 Authority Domain 中，并采用不同的写入、过期和纠错策略。
zh-CN.whyItMatters: 混在一起可能让某个用户的偏好覆盖权威知识，甚至污染其他用户的 Context。

en.summary: Hybrid structured/unstructured search combines semantic or lexical retrieval with filters, fields, relations, and exact structured constraints.
en.mentalModel: Use unstructured search to find meaning and structured queries to enforce known entities, dates, permissions, or relationships; fuse results deliberately.
en.whyItMatters: When evidence spans documents and structured records, either retrieval style alone can miss critical constraints.

zh-CN.summary: 结构化与非结构化混合搜索，把语义或关键词检索与字段、Filter、关系和精确结构约束结合起来。
zh-CN.mentalModel: 用非结构化搜索寻找语义，用结构化查询约束实体、日期、权限或关系，再显式融合两类结果。
zh-CN.whyItMatters: 当证据同时分布在文档和结构化记录中时，单独依赖任何一种检索方式都可能遗漏关键约束。

en.summary: MCP Tasks and elicitation-style interactions extend a single request/response tool call into multi-round-trip work with explicit lifecycle and user-input boundaries.
en.mentalModel: Treat long-running task state, elicited information, cancellation, and completion as protocol/application responsibilities rather than hidden conversational state.
en.whyItMatters: This version-sensitive boundary matters when MCP workflows become asynchronous or require structured user participation across multiple turns.

zh-CN.summary: MCP Tasks 与 Elicitation 类交互把一次 Request/Response 工具调用扩展为具有生命周期和用户输入边界的多轮交互。
zh-CN.mentalModel: 把长任务状态、Elicited 信息、取消与完成语义视为 Protocol/Application 责任，而不是隐藏在对话状态里。
zh-CN.whyItMatters: 当 MCP 工作流变成异步任务或需要跨多轮的结构化用户参与时，这个版本敏感边界会直接影响系统正确性。

en.summary: Planning and direct execution are two runtime strategies: planning adds an intermediate decision process, while direct execution acts from the current state immediately.
en.mentalModel: Choose planning only when decomposing or comparing alternatives can materially improve the next action; otherwise prefer the simpler direct loop.
en.whyItMatters: Unnecessary planning increases latency, token cost, and stale assumptions without necessarily improving outcomes.

zh-CN.summary: Planning 与 Direct Execution 是两种 Runtime 策略：前者增加显式中间决策过程，后者根据当前状态直接行动。
zh-CN.mentalModel: 只有当拆解或比较替代方案能够显著改善下一步动作时才使用 Planning；否则优先保持更简单的 Direct Loop。
zh-CN.whyItMatters: 不必要的 Planning 会增加延迟、Token 成本和陈旧假设，却不一定改善结果。

en.summary: Environment observation reads the current visible or machine-readable state before an agent decides what action is valid.
en.mentalModel: Use an observe → interpret → act loop; never let a stale plan stand in for checking the state that the action will actually affect.
en.whyItMatters: Interfaces change and actions have side effects, so stale state can make an otherwise correct browser or computer-use plan unsafe.

zh-CN.summary: Environment Observation 是 Agent 在决定可执行动作之前，先读取当前可见或机器可读的环境状态。
zh-CN.mentalModel: 采用 Observe → Interpret → Act 循环；不要让旧 Plan 替代对实际操作目标状态的重新检查。
zh-CN.whyItMatters: 界面会变化、操作存在 Side Effect，陈旧状态会让原本正确的 Browser/Computer Use 计划变得不安全。

en.summary: Independent verification separates the producer of an answer or action from the mechanism that checks it, reducing shared assumptions and correlated failure.
en.mentalModel: A verifier should receive the evidence and acceptance criteria it needs without inheriting every hidden assumption of the producer.
en.whyItMatters: Adding more agents only improves reliability when their failures are not perfectly correlated.

zh-CN.summary: Independent Verification 把答案或动作的生产者与检查机制分离，从而减少共享假设和相关性失败。
zh-CN.mentalModel: Verifier 应获得完成检查所需的证据与验收标准，但不应继承 Producer 的全部隐含假设。
zh-CN.whyItMatters: 只有不同角色的失败不是高度相关时，增加 Agent 才可能真正提高可靠性。

en.summary: Outcome evaluation judges the final result; trajectory evaluation also inspects the actions, tool calls, and decisions used to reach it.
en.mentalModel: Use outcome metrics for end-state quality and trajectory evidence when unsafe, wasteful, or brittle paths can still produce a superficially correct result.
en.whyItMatters: Two agent runs can end at the same answer while one violates policy, wastes resources, or relies on an unrecoverable path.

zh-CN.summary: Outcome Evaluation 评估最终结果；Trajectory Evaluation 还会检查到达结果之前的动作、工具调用和决策序列。
zh-CN.mentalModel: 最终质量用 Outcome Metric 判断；当危险、浪费或脆弱路径也可能得到表面正确结果时，再加入 Trajectory Evidence。
zh-CN.whyItMatters: 两个 Agent Run 可能得到同样答案，但其中一个可能违规、浪费资源或走了不可恢复的路径。

en.summary: Cross-layer architecture separates model behavior, context/retrieval, tools, runtime state, policy, and product guarantees so failures can be assigned to the layer that can control them.
en.mentalModel: Do not solve every problem in the prompt; map each requirement to the layer that has the authority and observability to enforce it.
en.whyItMatters: Production AI failures often come from responsibility leaking between layers rather than from one isolated model error.

zh-CN.summary: Cross-layer Architecture 把模型行为、Context/Retrieval、Tools、Runtime State、Policy 和产品保证拆到不同责任层。
zh-CN.mentalModel: 不要试图用 Prompt 解决所有问题；把每个要求放到真正拥有 Enforcement 权限和可观测性的那一层。
zh-CN.whyItMatters: 生产 AI 的很多失败并不是单个模型错误，而是责任在不同层之间泄漏造成的。

en.summary: Queue backpressure controls how producers, workers, and downstream services behave when incoming work exceeds safe processing capacity.
en.mentalModel: Model queue depth, concurrency limits, admission control, retry behavior, and cancellation together so overload slows or sheds work instead of cascading.
en.whyItMatters: Uncontrolled concurrency turns latency spikes into retry storms, duplicate work, and resource exhaustion in long-running or agent workloads.

zh-CN.summary: Queue Backpressure 用来控制当输入工作量超过安全处理能力时，Producer、Worker 和下游服务应该如何响应。
zh-CN.mentalModel: 把 Queue Depth、Concurrency Limit、Admission Control、Retry 和 Cancellation 一起设计，让过载时系统能够减速或丢弃工作，而不是级联失效。
zh-CN.whyItMatters: 在长任务或 Agent 工作负载中，失控并发会把延迟尖峰放大成 Retry Storm、重复工作和资源耗尽。

en.summary: Inference serving turns a chosen model into an operational service by managing memory, batching, quantization, concurrency, latency, and deployment constraints.
en.mentalModel: Treat serving as a systems problem: the same model can have very different cost and latency profiles depending on runtime, hardware, batching, and precision choices.
en.whyItMatters: Model quality alone does not determine whether an adapted model is practical to deploy or economical to operate.

zh-CN.summary: Inference Serving 把选定模型变成可运营服务，需要管理内存、Batching、Quantization、Concurrency、Latency 和部署约束。
zh-CN.mentalModel: 把 Serving 当作系统问题：同一个模型会因为 Runtime、硬件、Batching 和精度选择不同而呈现完全不同的成本与延迟。
zh-CN.whyItMatters: 模型质量本身并不能决定一个适配后的模型是否真正可部署、可承受。

en.summary: Source-backed drafting ties factual claims to known sources while the text is written instead of adding citations after unsupported prose already exists.
en.mentalModel: Draft from an evidence set and preserve claim-to-source links so later revision can update or remove claims when sources change.
en.whyItMatters: Fluent unsupported text becomes expensive to verify once it has propagated across chapters and arguments.

zh-CN.summary: Source-backed Drafting 是在写作过程中就把事实性 Claim 绑定到已知 Source，而不是先生成无依据正文再事后补引用。
zh-CN.mentalModel: 从 Evidence Set 出发写作，并保留 Claim → Source 连接，使来源变化时可以定位并更新或删除相关内容。
zh-CN.whyItMatters: 无证据的流畅文本一旦扩散到多个章节和论证中，后续验证成本会非常高。

en.summary: Knowledge curation continually decides what enters a knowledge base, what stays authoritative, what must be updated, and what should be retired.
en.mentalModel: Treat ingestion as an editorial lifecycle with ownership, provenance, freshness, duplication, and deletion rules—not as a one-time upload job.
en.whyItMatters: Retrieval quality cannot remain high when the corpus accumulates stale, conflicting, or ownerless material.

zh-CN.summary: Knowledge Curation 是持续决定哪些内容进入知识库、哪些保持权威、哪些需要更新、哪些应该淘汰的工作。
zh-CN.mentalModel: 把 Ingestion 当作带 Owner、Provenance、Freshness、去重和删除规则的编辑生命周期，而不是一次性上传任务。
zh-CN.whyItMatters: 如果 Corpus 不断积累陈旧、冲突或无人负责的材料，再好的 Retrieval 也无法长期保持质量。

en.summary: Research synthesis combines evidence into a conclusion while preserving uncertainty, source disagreement, and unresolved questions instead of averaging them away.
en.mentalModel: Separate supported consensus, conflicting evidence, and open gaps; synthesize the evidence structure before writing a single narrative conclusion.
en.whyItMatters: A smooth summary can hide the exact disagreements that should change a decision or trigger further research.

zh-CN.summary: Research Synthesis 是把证据组合成结论，同时保留不确定性、来源分歧和未解决问题，而不是把它们平均掉。
zh-CN.mentalModel: 先区分已支持的共识、冲突证据和开放缺口，再综合 Evidence Structure，最后才形成叙事性结论。
zh-CN.whyItMatters: 流畅摘要很容易隐藏真正应该改变决策或触发继续研究的关键分歧。

en.summary: Structured analysis separates extraction, normalization, calculation, interpretation, and synthesis so each transformation can be checked independently.
en.mentalModel: Turn messy material into explicit tables, fields, assumptions, and intermediate results before asking the model for a final narrative.
en.whyItMatters: Unverifiable reasoning often enters when raw evidence and interpretation are collapsed into one opaque generation step.

zh-CN.summary: Structured Analysis 把抽取、标准化、计算、解释和综合拆开，使每次数据转换都可以独立检查。
zh-CN.mentalModel: 先把杂乱材料转成明确的表格、字段、假设和中间结果，再让模型生成最终叙事。
zh-CN.whyItMatters: 如果原始证据和解释被压在一次黑盒生成里，最容易混入无法验证的推断。

en.summary: Knowledge-product publishing packages reviewed learning content into a versioned, navigable, distributable artifact with clear ownership and release criteria.
en.mentalModel: Publishing is a release step: validate completeness, media, rights, navigation, versioning, and update ownership before distribution.
en.whyItMatters: A good curriculum can still fail as a product when learners cannot navigate it, trust its version, or receive maintained updates.

zh-CN.summary: Knowledge Product Publishing 是把经过审查的学习内容打包成有版本、可导航、可分发并有明确 Owner 的产品。
zh-CN.mentalModel: 把 Publishing 当作 Release：发布前检查完整性、媒体质量、版权、导航、版本以及后续维护责任。
zh-CN.whyItMatters: 即使课程内容很好，如果学习者无法导航、无法确认版本或得不到持续更新，知识产品仍会失败。

en.summary: A content-marketing system connects customer questions, reusable content production, distribution, measurement, and feedback into a repeatable operating loop.
en.mentalModel: Treat content as an owned pipeline with inputs, cadence, channels, conversion signals, and maintenance—not as isolated AI-generated posts.
en.whyItMatters: For a solo business, repeatability and feedback compound while one-off generation quickly becomes an unsustainable queue of assets.

zh-CN.summary: Content Marketing System 把客户问题、可复用内容生产、分发、测量和反馈连接成可重复运营循环。
zh-CN.mentalModel: 把内容当作有输入、节奏、渠道、转化信号和维护责任的 Pipeline，而不是一堆独立 AI 生成帖子。
zh-CN.whyItMatters: 对一人公司而言，可重复流程和反馈会产生复利，而一次性生成只会快速积累难以维护的素材。
